title: Preview: one simulated week of the automated lab, moved by the event log (digital twin)
description:
A preview, for review: one simulated week (days 120-126) of the digital twin's replayed year, with PR 318's 3-D lab moved by the twin's event log. Simulated, not lab results.

Every tray presented at a Kardex Shuttle's opening and every MiR250 + UR12e visit to a dock comes from a booking in the event log (out/twin2/events/vertical_lab_bofn_blend_s0.json): a station on a tray has its tray brought to the opening when the booking starts and again when it ends, and a floor machine has a unit dock at its front. Idle trays stay in their slots.

The clock runs at 2.8 lab hours a second. At that speed a tray change (8-12 s with the tower's own timings) would last a few thousandths of a second, so the moves run on their own clock, 8 times real time, each starting when the clock reaches its booking: the lift at 1333 mm/s, the 2.2 s slides, the 0.7 s shutter, the MiR250 at 1.5 m/s pivoting at 60 deg/s, the arm's pick and place. When the moves can't keep up, each Shuttle and unit takes the latest request. This week: 73 of 138 tray requests and 40 of 58 machine visits are drawn (the panel at the bottom says so).

Overlays as in the campaign video: stations lit from the event log, the two function networks, the compositions in progress, the live best-so-far plots. The inset is a second camera on the two Shuttles.
